modules.name: Zairenkai System Module (Core)

magisk.evidence: Magisk docs/changes.md v21.2: 'Fix the magisk --install-module command'; the module's update-binary needs v20.4+

kernelsu.evidence: ksud cli.rs: module install|uninstall|list (tiann/KernelSU 6d31a61, KernelSU-Next b427a3f)

risks: zcored starts at boot from service.sh and restarts at most 5 times in 10 minutes.
Removing the module stops zcored, which restores any temporary override it made, and deletes /data/adb/zairenkai-core.

destinations.data: /data/adb/zairenkai-core (customize.sh creates it 0700; config.toml there is kept across installs)

lifecycle.startup: service.sh waits for sys.boot_completed, then runs bin/zcored run --dir /data/adb/zairenkai-core under a supervisor: exponential backoff, at most 5 starts in 10 minutes, then it stops and writes /data/adb/zairenkai-core/failed
lifecycle.shutdown: the supervisor stops when the manager's disable or remove marker exists; zcored restores temporary overrides on SIGTERM
lifecycle.uninstall: uninstall.sh sends SIGTERM to zcored, waits up to 30 s, then deletes /data/adb/zairenkai-core
lifecycle.recovery: disable or remove the module in the root manager (or its safe mode); /data/adb/zairenkai-core/failed and zcored.log record start failures
lifecycle.kernel: none beyond Android 10+ arm64 (customize.sh checks ARCH and API)
lifecycle.action: action.sh prints zcored ctl health (the manager's Action button)

modules.distribution_reason: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE and NOTICE at the pinned commit, inside the zip)
